mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (account_id, message, type, related_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{message}, #{type}, #{relatedId})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE is_read = 1 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
